reasons: The document excerpt confirms the miscellaneous provisions end at § 30 (Force Majeure) with no insurance covenant, and the rule's detection guidance treats an absent insurance clause for a hosting vendor as an insert-type finding.

The inserted Section 31 tracks the model language closely (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request), adapts it to the Agreement's actual party name and defined terms (Client Content, Credit Data), and is placed sensibly after § 30 and before the signature block without disturbing existing text.

The comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, correctly cites the playbook position and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback; no over-flagging concern arises since there is no existing clause at preferred or fallback level.
Deterministic checks pass and the high change ratio is inherent to an insertion-type remedy.
